name: Hana Nakamura
source:
Hana Nakamura, the middle daughter of the Nakamuras. She's a carefree and kind girl. Due to her beauty she got a lot of unwanted attention growing up, but [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]you[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c148175]Naomi[/url] were always there to put those people back in their place.
